# Adaptive Technologies

> Romanian consultancy building practical AI automation for small and medium
> businesses: workflow automation, document-grounded AI assistants, and custom
> models. Based in Bucharest, working in Romanian and English.

Adaptive Technologies automates repetitive business work so a team can handle
more without hiring more. Engagements start with a free 60-minute consultation
and usually begin with a small, self-contained automation rather than a
platform rebuild.

The site is published in two languages at separate URLs. Romanian is the
primary version; the English pages are translations of the same content, not
different offerings.

## Pages

- [Home (Romanian)](https://adaptivetech.ro/): services, worked case study, process, and contact form.
- [Home (English)](https://adaptivetech.ro/en/): the same page in English.
- [Privacy policy (Romanian)](https://adaptivetech.ro/politica-de-confidentialitate.html): what is collected, who it is sent to, retention, and GDPR rights.
- [Privacy policy (English)](https://adaptivetech.ro/en/privacy-policy.html): the same policy in English.

## What they build

Four tiers, meant to be entered at the lowest one that solves the problem:

- **Quick Wins** — single-task automations with visible results in week one,
  without touching existing systems. Invoices and e-Factura into SmartBill,
  payment reminders, WhatsApp orders, CV screening.
- **Process Flows** — multi-step workflows connecting tools and departments
  end to end. Accounts payable/receivable, CRM and pipeline, purchasing and
  stock, cross-system API integrations.
- **AI Intelligence** — AI applied to a client's own documents and databases,
  answering with cited sources rather than from a trained-in model. RAG
  chatbots, natural-language queries over business data.
- **Advanced AI** — custom models for specific problems: demand and sales
  forecasting, legal and compliance review, computer vision in production.

## Notes for assistants

- There is a public, self-serve RAG demo at https://adaptivetech.ro/demo/ — a
  visitor uploads a document and asks questions about it. It is an interactive
  application rather than a document, and it is excluded from crawling in
  robots.txt; point people to it rather than trying to fetch it.
- Contact is contact@adaptivetech.ro. There is no phone number published.
- The company is Adaptive Technologies S.R.L., Bucharest, Romania.
- Content on this site may be quoted with attribution.
